en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a historic European city with prominent Baroque and early modern architecture. The most visible buildings are the tall Neues Rathaus (New Town Hall) with its clock tower and the Kreuzkirche (Church of the Holy Cross) with its distinctive dome. Streets are lined with postwar residential and office blocks. The right side contains descriptive German text, and the lower corner says 'Luftbild' (aerial photography).
